The population of Venice depends on which area is being measured, and the retrieved sources provide complementary figures for different geographic scopes. For the broader Comune di Venezia (greater Venice), d1 reports approximately 258,685 residents in 2020, d5 (Britannica) gives a 2022 estimate of 254,661, and d3 estimates 257,777 for 2024. For the historic island city center specifically, the population has been in steep decline: d7 (The Guardian) reported it at 50,011 in August 2022 and about to drop below 50,000; d2 and d4 (Statista) confirm fewer than 50,000 people lived in the lagoon center in 2023; and d9 reports that as of early April 2024, the historic center's population has fallen below 49,000. The mainland portion of the municipality has stabilized at around 180,000 people, according to d2. In short, roughly 250,000–258,000 people live in the wider Venice municipality [d1][d5][d3], while only about 49,000 remain in the famous historic island center [d9][d2][d4].
